highlights.title: Far-Right Vigilantes Have Inflamed France’s Unrest, Officials Say
highlights.summary: Through weeks of antigovernment unrest, hard-right activists have fought with left-wing counterparts in at least 10 towns, according to national and regional leaders.

highlights.title: Abroad, Spain’s Leader Is a Left-Wing Hero. Will He Lose Power at Home?
highlights.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, a staunch critic of President Trump, faces an uphill task to overcome a right-wing challenge in the national election on Sunday.

highlights.title: FIFA May Scrap the Peace Prize It Gave to Trump
highlights.summary: Gianni Infantino, the global soccer body’s leader, has stirred concern over his ties to President Trump. Now FIFA is rethinking the award he gave Mr. Trump last year.

highlights.title: Behind India’s IIT dream: Student suicides and gaps in support
highlights.summary: Rishikesh Kumar made it to IIT, but died months later in a suspected suicide, reviving questions about student support.

highlights.title: El Nino-linked deluges flood cities in Peru, Ecuador
highlights.summary: Heavy rains affect 2,000 families in Peru's Piura and 47,000 people in Ecuador, where 34 deaths have been reported.

highlights.title: UN chief frontrunner urged to speak out over Albanese detention
highlights.summary: Albanese's detention poses a test for Costa Rica's candidate, Rebeca Grynspan, who has led the UN's recent straw poll.
